Compute Ecoacoustic Soundscape Indices for a Single Audio File

Source: R/02b_soundscape.R
pam_soundscape_one.Rd

Reads WAV or FLAC via pam_read_audio, optionally downsamples to 24 kHz, applies a high-pass filter at sub-window level, and computes configured acoustic indices (ACI, ADI, AEve, Bio, H, M, NDSI).

Usage

pam_soundscape_one(
  audio_path,
  low_stop_hz = NULL,
  cfg = NULL,
  window_sec = NULL
)

Arguments

audio_path

Character. Path to input audio file (.wav or .flac).

low_stop_hz

Numeric. Highpass low-stop frequency in Hz (default 500).

cfg

List. Parsed configuration structure from pam_config_read.

window_sec

Numeric. Optional window duration in seconds.

Value

A data.table with file/window metadata and index values.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("soundecology", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ex <- pam_example_project()
  # the example tones are only 2 s long and 8 kHz, so some indices come out as NA
  pam_soundscape_one(ex$files[1], cfg = ex$cfg)
}
